mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.execution_id AS executionId, e.execution_no AS executionNo, e.workorder_id AS workorderId, w.code AS workorderCode, w.source, m.code AS productCode, m.name AS productName, u.name AS unitName, r.routing_node_id AS routingNodeId, n.operation_name AS operationName, r.record_type AS recordType, r.quantity_delta AS quantityDelta, r.operator_user_id AS operatorUserId, r.report_time AS reportTime, r.create_time AS createTime FROM ( SELECT id, execution_id, routing_node_id, record_type, quantity_delta, operator_user_id, report_time, create_time FROM mes_production_report ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) r LEFT JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.id = r.execution_id LEFT JOIN workorder w ON w.id = e.workorder_id LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id = e.product_id LEFT JOIN unit_measure u ON u.id = m.unit_id LEFT JOIN routing_node n ON n.id = r.routing_node_id AND n.routing_id = e.routing_id ORDER BY r.id DESC
